narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three plus two is five, so four cubed, squared, is four to the power five.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Count the fours one by one. Two groups of three fours make six fours in all.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The bubble counts only five fours, which is one four too few.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows (4³)² = 4⁵; the two groups of three 4s are counted, 6 in all; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A power of a power has groups of equal factors. Count every factor in every group.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Find three to the power six in two different ways.
